description: The plot titled “Whisper fine-tunning, type = small” illustrates how WER changes over training epochs for multiple small-model configurations. The x-axis is labeled “epoch,” uses a linear scale, and runs from 0 to 6 with integer tick marks at every 1 epoch. The y-axis is labeled “WER,” uses a linear scale, and spans roughly from 25 to 42.5 with regularly spaced tick labels every 2.5 units. Four orange lines are shown: (1) a solid line with circle markers labeled “small AdaLoRA_int4,” which decreases steadily from about 35.6 at epoch 0 to about 30.5 at epoch 6 (with intermediate points near 34.7 at epoch 1 and 32.1 at epoch 4); (2) a solid line with square markers labeled “small AdaLoRA_int8,” which declines from about 30.0 at epoch 0 to about 25.0 at epoch 6, passing through about 28.6 at epoch 2 and about 26.5 at epoch 5; (3) a dashed line with circle markers labeled “small int4,” which rises from about 35.6 at epoch 0 to a peak near 42.2 at epoch 2, then decreases to about 31.5 by epoch 6 (with values around 38.7 at epoch 3 and 34.0 at epoch 5); and (4) a dashed line with square markers (legend text appears as “-”), which increases from about 30.0 at epoch 0 to about 33.8 at epoch 2, then drops to about 29.4 at epoch 3 and continues downward to about 25.4 at epoch 5 before ending near 25.9 at epoch 6.
